reason: DeepTrace primarily processes local DSH session logs into deterministic usage, cost, risk, activity, and collaboration reports with visual and document exports; the README states that analysis is read-only and does not automatically modify configurations.

summaries.zh: 深迹将本地 DSH 会话事件日志聚合为包含成本、调用、风险、活动和改进线索的可视化报告，并支持多种格式导出。
summaries.en: DeepTrace aggregates local DSH session event logs into visual reports covering cost, calls, risks, activity, and improvement signals, with exports in multiple formats.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session event logs
Aggregates session, token, cost, model, tool-call, retry, risk, and activity data
Generates deterministic reports in web, Markdown, HTML, PDF, PNG, and CLI formats
Inspects logs for common secret-pattern presence and dangerous-operation indicators
Can query supported provider balance information when configured
